other_failure_modes.name: Look-ahead bias via lead features
other_failure_modes.description: The agent generates features by looking ahead into future time steps (e.g., shifting values backwards). In a time series forecasting context, this leaks future information (and potentially test set data) into the training set, rendering the model invalid for real-world forward-looking predictions.

summary: The agent implements a thorough feature engineering pipeline with domain-specific transformations for weather data. However, the solution suffers from critical time series data leakage: it uses a randomized K-Fold cross-validation strategy that ignores temporal order, and it explicitly constructs 'lead' features that look into the future, fundamentally invalidating the predictive model.
